title: Reform Of The Prison System In The UK
description: Bài đọc về cải cách hệ thống nhà tù tại Vương quốc Anh

words.example: The UK's large prison population is fuelled by a high level of recidivism.
words.collocation: high level of recidivism · reduce recidivism · rate of recidivism
words.note: Từ học thuật quan trọng trong chủ đề Crime. Thường đi với 'rate' hoặc 'level'.

words.example: The UK's large prison population is fuelled by a high level of recidivism - when criminals repeatedly relapse into crime.
words.collocation: relapse into crime · relapse into old habits · risk of relapse
words.note: Cũng dùng trong y tế: 'relapse into illness' (bệnh tái phát).

words.vi: Sự phục hồi, sự cải tạo
words.example: This project for a model prison tackles issues of architecture, management and funding in an enlightened attempt to achieve lasting rehabilitation.
words.collocation: lasting rehabilitation · promote rehabilitation · rehabilitation programme
words.note: Từ trọng tâm của bài. Đối lập với 'punishment' (trừng phạt).

words.example: The penal system is one of the most direct manifestations of the power of the state.
words.collocation: penal system · penal reform · penal code

words.vi: Sự biểu hiện, sự thể hiện
words.example: The penal system is one of the most direct manifestations of the power of the state.
words.collocation: direct manifestation · physical manifestation · manifestation of

words.example: The penal system is often also a revealing reflection of the national psyche.
words.collocation: national psyche · human psyche · collective psyche
words.note: Đọc là /ˈsaɪ.ki/, không đọc theo chữ. Gốc Hy Lạp.

words.example: Surprisingly, for a prosperous, progressive Western democracy, the UK has a lamentable penal record.
words.collocation: lamentable record · lamentable failure · lamentable state

words.example: Surprisingly, for a prosperous, progressive Western democracy, the UK has a lamentable penal record.
words.collocation: prosperous country · prosperous economy · increasingly prosperous

words.example: The average cost of keeping an individual prisoner incarcerated for a year is £27,000.
words.collocation: be incarcerated · incarcerate criminals · mass incarceration
words.note: Trang trọng hơn 'imprison'. Danh từ: incarceration.

words.example: The average cost is ten times the average expenditure on a secondary school pupil in the state sector.
words.collocation: average expenditure · public expenditure · expenditure on
words.note: Trang trọng hơn 'spending'. Hay gặp trong IELTS Writing Task 1.

words.vi: Sự quá tải, quá đông đúc
words.example: Overcrowding is endemic, hampering opportunities for education and rehabilitation.
words.collocation: prison overcrowding · tackle overcrowding · serious overcrowding

words.vi: Phổ biến, lan tràn (trong một khu vực)
words.example: Overcrowding is endemic, hampering opportunities for education and rehabilitation and lowering staff and prisoner morale.
words.collocation: endemic corruption · endemic problem · endemic to
words.note: Cũng dùng trong y tế chỉ bệnh đặc hữu của một vùng.

words.example: Overcrowding is endemic, hampering opportunities for education and rehabilitation.
words.collocation: hamper efforts · hamper progress · seriously hamper

words.example: Overcrowding is lowering staff and prisoner morale.
words.collocation: low morale · boost morale · staff morale

words.vi: Mù chữ, không biết đọc biết viết
words.example: At least 60 per cent of whom are functionally illiterate and innumerate.
words.collocation: functionally illiterate · computer illiterate · illiterate population
words.note: Trái nghĩa: literate. 'Functionally illiterate' = biết chữ nhưng không đủ để dùng trong đời thường.

words.example: At least 60 per cent of whom are functionally illiterate and innumerate.
words.collocation: functionally innumerate · largely innumerate
words.synonyms: unable to do maths · poor with numbers
words.note: Trái nghĩa: numerate. Cấu tạo tương tự 'illiterate'.

words.vi: Có thể nhận ra, nhận biết được
words.example: Prison architecture has a clearly discernible effect on behaviour, operational efficiency, interaction and morale.
words.collocation: clearly discernible · no discernible difference · discernible effect

words.vi: Bản thiết kế, kế hoạch chi tiết
words.example: The model is not intended as a blueprint but rather a series of principles.
words.collocation: a blueprint for · provide a blueprint · detailed blueprint
words.note: Nghĩa gốc: bản vẽ kỹ thuật. Nghĩa bóng: kế hoạch tổng thể.

words.vi: Tù nhân, người bị giam giữ
words.example: The system groups together prisoners in small communities or 'houses' of between 30 and 40 inmates.
words.collocation: prison inmate · fellow inmate · inmate population
words.note: Cũng dùng cho người trong bệnh viện tâm thần.

words.example: Individual cells are replanned to make them less like domestic lavatories and more conducive to learning.
words.collocation: conducive to learning · conducive to growth · conducive environment
words.note: Luôn đi với 'to': conducive to + N/V-ing.

words.example: Each cell is paired with a neighbouring 'buddy' cell linked by sliding doors to mitigate the risk of self-harm.
words.collocation: mitigate the risk · mitigate the impact · mitigate against
words.note: Từ hay gặp trong IELTS Writing Task 2 khi bàn về giải pháp.

words.example: Houses are semi-autonomous, not just dormitories, with communal, as opposed to centralised, facilities.
words.collocation: semi-autonomous · autonomous region · fully autonomous

words.vi: Sự tuân thủ, sự phù hợp
words.example: The prisoners are judged not by their degree of conformity, but by the scope of their activities and achievements.
words.collocation: in conformity with · degree of conformity · social conformity

words.example: The proposed group size of 30-40 has the potential for social accountability.
words.collocation: social accountability · public accountability · accountability for

words.example: We have got to accept that prison must be a humane and constructive place.
words.collocation: humane treatment · humane conditions · humane society
